name: KIC 1164584
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 12.2 solar radii and 1.19 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 1164584 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 12.1595 +/- 0.2247

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 1164584 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.1945 +/- 0.0495

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 1164584 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4341.502 +/- 41.8483

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 1164584 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.3435 +/- 0.0042

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.19 solar masses and 12.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,342 K at its surface.
